evidence.claim: Nifty fell 0.88% to 22,421.95, eighth straight weekly loss; FPIs sold Rs 10,148cr Wednesday, ~$27.8bn YTD; Brent around $100.
USD led on Oct 1; US 10y at 5.24%; WTI +$2.55 to $92.97.

thesis: Rupee weakness has persistent drivers that are not exhausted: record FPI equity outflows (Rs 10,148cr sold Sep 30, ~$27.8bn YTD), Brent near $100 widening the import bill, US 10y ~5.2%. USDINR above 20/50d averages (96.30 vs 95.64/95.47). Main risk: RBI MPC decision Oct 7 or heavy RBI intervention caps the move; hence modest probability.
